0.literal: You can switch the player character.
0.official: Choose "Switch to Majima" from that list to change protagonists.

1.literal: You'll be able to switch the player character back to Kiryu again...
1.official: you will have the opportunity to return to Kiryu

2.official: There's another guy... fighting to become a real yakuza right now.

3.literal: He let the Nikkyo Consortium keep the woman hidden away...
3.official: He let the Consortium take her... watched how they moved.

4.literal: He's going to wipe out every last one of you...
4.official: He needs all of you gone...

5.literal: You're headed into the deepest part of the yakuza world...
5.official: You're about to step into the... the deepest, darkest, shit pit of the yakuza world.

6.literal: Because I don't want anybody butting in where they don't belong.
6.official: No jackasses standin' in the way now of you and me doing this for real.

7.literal: Heh, the one in command of it now is Shibusawa, but...
7.official: Heh, it's Shibusawa calling the shots now,

8.literal: No matter who's doing it, it's not that hard a job.
8.official: but whoever's in charge has a simple enough job.

9.literal: But me... no matter how many small fry come at me...
9.official: But I'd rather fight a hundred Tojo punks than go one-on-one with you right now.

10.literal: You... came here just to beat me down...
10.official: You're here for one reason... to break me.

11.literal: ...I'm going to settle this with you, Kuze-aniki.

12.literal: So the one giving the orders is Shibusawa.
12.official: The order's coming from Shibusawa, right?

13.literal: Nishiki. Makoto Makimura was being protected by Sera of the Nikkyo Consortium.
13.official: Nishiki. Makoto is with Sera from the Nikkyo Consortium.

14.literal: It'll be the trump card for Sera and Pops Kazama.
14.official: as long as she stays that way, that lot is Sera and Kazama's ace in the hole.

15.literal: If we get through this and buy some time...
15.official: If we can just get through this and buy some time, hopefully things will change.

16.literal: Don't talk so big. Every last one of you is getting slaughtered.
16.official: Heh, big talk from Kazama's little errand boy. Every last one of you is getting buried.

17.literal: He forced his way into the Kazama Family office and...
17.official: He stormed the Kazama Family office

18.literal: On behalf of the Chinese people who live in Little Asia, I thank you.
18.official: I speak for all Little Asia's residents when I say thank you.

19.literal: She's made it past the critical point for now, but she's still in a dangerous condition.
19.official: She's past the worst of it, post-surgery, but her condition's still unstable.

20.literal: They've wasted no time and started moving to get the Kamurocho redevelopment project underway in earnest.
20.official: They're back to work on the Kamurocho Revitalization Project in earnest now.

21.literal: Now he's trying to protect her from the bottom of his heart.
21.official: but now... I believe he sincerely wants to keep her safe.

22.literal: He played by the rules and patiently endured while building up his strength.
22.official: He's kept quiet and built up his forces, patient and thorough.

23.literal: They need to demonstrate real strength.
23.official: they need a show of strength.

24.literal: A thorough elimination of the "old Kazama faction."
24.official: the first thing on his list's a thorough purge of Kazama's old guard.

25.literal: You in particular will be their number one target.

26.literal: That man... [chose us as the ones who] can stop the Dojima Family's expansion now...
26.official: He wants to prevent the Dojima Family from growing any more powerful, and he chose me and the Nikkyo Consortium as the counterbalance.

27.literal: It's so he could install me as the Tojo Clan's successor.
27.official: The ultimate goal was to thwart Sohei Dojima by establishing me as the Tojo Clan's successor instead of him.

28.literal: He's the one who taught me the ABCs of being a yakuza.
28.official: He was the one who first showed me the ropes as a yakuza.

29.literal: I had her moved from the hospital. [She's on a ship] moored at Shibaura...
29.official: I had her moved from the hospital. I have a ship docked in Tokyo Bay, at Shibaura. She's there.

30.literal: Gotta make sure I've got no lingering regrets...
30.official: Gotta make sure I go out with nothin' left undone.

31.literal: You really got nothin' left you'd regret, right?
31.official: Nothin' left on the bucket list?

33.literal: We couldn't face Tachibana, who died, either.
33.official: how are we ever gonna face Kazama-san again? ...Or Tachibana, when that time comes!?

35.official: If Shibusawa's gonna get his face caved in, it's gotta be you.

36.literal: So now you're Patriarch Dojima's bullet shield.
36.official: Kinda sad to see a guy like you end up as a meat shield for a guy like Patriarch Dojima.

37.literal: I can't believe you fought your way this deep into the Dojima Family.
37.official: You rolled up to the lion's den, punched your way through Dojima HQ just for that?

38.literal: ...Seems you've got no intention whatsoever of living smart.
38.official: Guess the thought of livin' wise never crossed your goddamn mind.

39.literal: A yakuza who lives the clever, calculating way is...
39.official: A yakuza tryin' to live the safe and comfy life is the only dumbass in the room.

40.literal: It's not about whether a way of living is right or wrong.
40.official: Hardly matters if your philosophy or mine's the right one.

41.literal: Instead of making excuses to me, why don't you hurry up and come at me...
41.official: If that's what ya really think, why don't ya come try me, 'stead of wastin' both our time with sorry excuses?

43.literal: my head just automatically starts working on how to talk my way around it...
43.official: My brain starts spinning up the speeches.

44.literal: Golf, women, pricey booze... it's all worthless nonsense.
44.official: Golf, women, expensive liquor... They're all bullshit.

45.official: The ink on my back's faded half to hell in the time I spent lost in the easy life.

46.literal: ...Even though I'm a yakuza to the core, at some point...
46.official: I was the yakuza mint, but somewhere along the line,

47.literal: spilling my own blood started to feel like a hassle...
47.official: gettin' bloody started feeling like a pain in the ass.

48.literal: playing the role of a clever yakuza wallowing in cash was...
48.official: I figured out that bein' the smart guy takin' baths in his cash was a helluva lot easier.

50.literal: Gotta throw 'em off my trail. This ain't the time for side trips.
50.official: I gotta use Hogushi Kaikan's hidden door to lose whoever's tailing me first.

51.literal: Wow, what a truly magnificent scattering of cash!

52.literal: I'd never take you for an ordinary commoner.
52.official: For a moment I completely forgot you were merely another plebian.

53.literal: Aren't there times when you don't want to get dragged into a fight either?
53.official: aren't there times when you're far too hurried to be embroiled in the petty squabbles of the underclass?

54.literal: To begin with, if you ask me, "time is money"...

55.literal: ...is about as big a lie as there is.

56.literal: When time is more precious than money.
56.official: Time is the far more precious resource. It's finite.

57.literal: You should try scattering some money around.
57.official: just let loose with a heaping helping of legal tender.

58.literal: I'm fully aware I'm asking for a lot.
58.official: Common sense tells me that's crazy to wish for, but I might as well ask.

59.literal: Try going to Theater Square. If you're truly rich...
59.official: Head for Theater Square. If you're truly a man of means, you'll find your way from there.

60.literal: And with that I make large profits.
60.official: I--or should I say, WE--put most of our capital to work in a certain system that gives rise to considerable profits.

62.literal: I've had quite a meaningful time.
62.official: This has been a most stimulating use of my time.

63.literal: That doesn't mean everything will be resolved.
63.official: but that doesn't mean everything will be over then.

64.literal: Hey, hey, pal. Hold on a sec.
64.official: Whoa there, buddy. Not so fast.

65.literal: What're you doing trying to walk past without a word?
65.official: You planning to just waltz past without a word?

66.literal: If you wanna get through here, you're gonna have to pay a toll.
66.official: You want through here, you gotta pay the toll.

67.literal: Shut up! You're the one who needs to move that foot!
67.official: Shut up! And move your freakin' leg!

68.literal: Honestly, poor people sure are a wretched bunch.
68.official: My, my. Peasants truly are a sordid lot.

70.literal: Losing time hurts a lot more.
70.official: having my precious time wasted by base ruffians like them is a serious loss.
